Area.evidence_source: Three key themes emerged from the interview data. These were termed Struggle, Control and Visibility, and covered experience before, at the time of and following an attempt. The themes are brought together in a model that illustrates their temporal positioning, shown in Figure 1. There was no set pattern in which themes came together for individual participants. Their intensity varied and at times they overlapped, illustrating the complexity of experience around the time of an attempt. Here we will explore each of the themes as they emerged in accounts of experience at various points along the pathway to and from the attempt. The context for these themes is the experience of ageing, and we also include the nature of participants' experience of, and response to, the process of getting older, which provides a backdrop to their accounts of the suicide attempt.
